title.tr: sant antoni pazar günü kitap pazarı.

line.en: old and second-hand books, stickers, postcards, stamps and games, open sunday mornings until about 14:00. go early.
line.de: alte und gebrauchte bücher, sticker, postkarten, briefmarken und spiele, sonntagvormittags bis etwa 14:00. früh hingehen.
line.tr: eski ve ikinci el kitaplar, çıkartmalar, kartpostallar, pullar ve oyunlar; pazar sabahları yaklaşık 14:00'a kadar açık. erken gidin.

sparks.why: Sant Antoni Sunday book market, Comte d'Urgell 1, open Sundays 08:30-14:00 per Barcelona city council markets page; Sun 29.11.
